scope: Actual visual inspection through view_image of the three named PNGs plus read-only metadata/CSV identity checks. No rerender or field/geometry/mechanics evaluation.

J_Hu.actual_view: Full-domain and jaw/body windows visibly use actual x1 positions. Red/cyan winning-cell outlines are visible; mechanism winner lies outside jaw/body window and remains visible in full-domain panels. Colorbar units, extrema text and footer are unobscured.
J_Hu.quantities: J minimum of9 saved samples is dimensionless/log color; Hu maximum absolute saved component is1/mm and has no quadrature index.

regions.actual_view: Origin0, peak5 and return11 positions are x1 and distinctly labelled. Bottom/left geometric witness segments and point markers are legible; tiny bottom segment is represented by its readable numerical label. Curves retain all12 indices, including the extra .25 return state.
regions.semantics: Dashed lines explicitly NOT force. Forward geometric lengths are not signed penetration, pressure or contact/clamp proof; mathematical cut versus physical rays is explained.

nodal_peak.actual_view: Peak accepted index5 is displayed as human ordinal6/12. Total/material/regularization panels use a common0.01N arrow key and x1 geometry. Purple cut and gold physical/cut shared-node markers are visible; no fixed-head zero-vector interior artifacts are apparent.
nodal_peak.sign: Force ON fixed lower-half body is negative saved internal force.
nodal_peak.group_semantics: Corners are not allocated exclusively to contact faces; cut is not presented as contact.
nodal_peak.moment: Derived Mz about[70,40]mm inN mm is readable and explicitly excluded from newHP/contact qualification.
nodal_peak.pressure: Footer clearly states nodal forces are not pressure.

output_hash_checks: Both field and region metadata output declarations match actual files. Node peak PNG SHA is independently recorded here; key_states does not declare PNG hashes.
actual_images_not_reviewed: Other node states, GIF and physical/cost images were outside this three-image request.
limitation: This visual pass confirms display/identity/readability only, not a repeated independent numerical qualification.
